title: F-Bench: Rethinking Human Preference Evaluation Metrics for Benchmarking Face Generation, Customization, and Restoration
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of AI-generated face images using dimensions such as quality, authenticity, and identity fidelity. It establishes a benchmark for image generation models and uses a Large Multimodal Model (LMM) for evaluation, but it does not involve evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
